en: Some scary people in blue barged in and went upstairs. My dad's up there! Please, help him!
Dad says the people in blue wanted something from upstairs. You chased them off, didn't you? Thank you!
We watch the weather all over Hoenn from here. Lately there have been odd readings: sudden rain, sudden sun.
Something out at sea, perhaps. It's as though the weather has a mind of its own.
Thank you for chasing Team Aqua off. They took our data on rain and storms, but at least they're gone.
There's a bed here... A little rest wouldn't hurt.
